sampling: Uniform without replacement within original hourly label classes, inverse inclusion weighting outside training
context: Latest available raw value and its age, observed 12-hour change and count, for each A/train-retained feature
calibration: Weighted isotonic regression fitted on A/calibration; no logistic or LSTM predictor
selection: Inverse-inclusion-weighted A/validation average precision, among completed fine-tuned epochs only
objective: Binary cross-entropy on Qwen's existing next-token logits for single tokens 0 and 1; no auxiliary classifier
test_scope: Exploratory sampled B comparison; B was previously evaluated and is not a fresh holdout
unsupported_metrics: Sparse endpoint sampling cannot estimate continuous alarm episodes, early detection timing or official Challenge utility
